There is a dedicated Rejoin Button in there Here Tab (looks like a pin on a map) in your Quick Menu.
This issue is also noted in the Developer Update from yesterday and will be fixed in an upcoming Open Beta Update.

details:
The (older) current menu system let you allow to re-enter the world. There are good reasons.
Some worlds can only reset or replayed after reload world. Or it's broken, then re-enter is needed.
Or some objects are gone already forever, then re-enter is needed to start over again and get them back.
Some creators want also test how syncing works with re-enter world. This menu will make testing impossible. :( You need existing channel to verify synced state as creator. This can turn in big problem with menu 2.0. I often use re-enter method to check my syncing side of the game, like for late-joiners.
Enough reasons. Not always need to make new channel.
But... new menu 2.0 refuses fully to re-enter world (click on JOIN button) and say you're already in the world. What? Am i really dumb person to re-enter the world? No, this is wrong choice and should just allow it. 
Maybe it's setup to prevent you accident enter same world. Sure, that might the idea of devs, but there are still other valid reasons.
If you want prevent mistakes, add CONFIRM panel to let you know if you really want re-enter the world with Yes or Go Back.
That is correct way. Full block it forces me to enter another world, then enter back to world. But this is problem if world is invite only, or it's full world. So please change this part of Menu 2.0. Now this is not friendly setup and too strict.
title: [1238] Not allowed to re-enter the world. Why?
